notes.title: The official soundtrack Cat's Request
notes.notes:
The official soundtrack for Cat's Request immerses the listener in the mystical world of the game. Compositions are created in various electronic styles. Most tunes are looped and can be played for hours.

Cat's Request Soundtrack is composed by BOV.
